summary: Implemented LINK-3 thread-anchor creation with temporary drag thread, target highlighting, duplicate/self/empty feedback, the Association/Provenance type menu, repository-backed create/retype, board-store selection, 12 component tests, and desktop/tablet Playwright journeys including reload persistence and touch-anchor drawing. Required unit, e2e, typecheck, lint, full-suite, and build checks pass.

decisions: Pointer routing stays on the DOM host; ThreadAnchor is a Pixi target with a 44 px screen-space DOM hit radius, so mouse and touch share one gesture state machine.
Creation always writes association first and the menu retypes the same connection row, so exactly one row exists per unordered pair.
The menu applies a type change optimistically, reverts on failure, and never reopens after dismissal during an in-flight retype.
Duplicate repository results teach the page the existing row through the upserting onConnectionChanged callback to survive stale snapshots or another tab.
interfaces: BoardCanvas onConnectionDrop: { fromCardId, toCardId: string | null, point: { clientX, clientY } }
ThreadAnchor exports threadAnchorScreenPoint, isPointOnThreadAnchor, findThreadAnchorAtPoint, computeDraftThreadGeometry, ThreadAnchor, ThreadAnchorLayer
ConnectionTypeMenu props type, provenanceEligible, provenanceReason, point, busy, onSelect, onDismiss
agentReportedTests: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/connections.spec.ts: 3 passed, 3 skipped (desktop + tablet main journey, tablet touch journey)
npm run build (via e2e): pass; separate BoardCanvas/Pixi chunks, no pixi in initial shell
warnings: Tablet 45 FPS at 150 cards remains unmeasured and needs human verification at LINK-HR-1.
Pre-existing HEAD e2e failures in board-drag.spec.ts and board.spec.ts were confirmed unrelated to LINK-3 in a clean HEAD worktree.
validationLimitations: Phone projects skip the pointer thread journeys; the canvas remains pointer-only and the accessible non-spatial path is LINK-5.
Pixel-level string color/pixel verification is covered by LINK-2 geometry tests and browser behavior, not a pixel assertion in this LINK-3 journey.
payload.taskDescription: Implement ThreadAnchor as a Pixi interaction target at the selected card edge, mount it through CardSprite, add a temporary drag thread, target highlighting, drop handling, and a ConnectionTypeMenu with Association and Provenance. Default to association on drop. Disable provenance with an explanation unless the pair is note to source. Reject self-links and duplicates, selecting the existing connection and showing a toast. Wire creation through ConnectionRepository and the board store. Add component tests for the hook and menu, plus a Playwright journey that draws two strings, retypes one to provenance, and verifies persistence after reload.
